description: Audits a public store homepage (+ robots.txt, sitemap, one sampled product page) and returns a heuristic 0–100 AI-shopping readiness score with the top ≤10 gaps and fixes (schema.org Product/Offer, AI search bots in robots.txt, sitemap, HTTPS, policies). Read-only; no login; does not detect WAF/CDN bot blocking.

store_url.description: URL público http(s). (Caminhos locais só com SHOPAIREADY_ALLOW_LOCAL=1, para demo/testes.)

name: check_store_ai_readiness
title: Check store AI-shopping readiness
